The Chinese characters for Jordan

As a transliteration, Jordan is usually written 乔丹 (Qiáo dān). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

乔
Qiáo
tall, lofty
丹
dān
cinnabar, red

Origin and meaning

Jordan is a Hebrew name meaning “flowing down (the River Jordan)”.

About the name Jordan

Named after the River Jordan, where Jesus was baptised.

As a gift or a tattoo

Because it means “flowing down (the River Jordan)”, a Jordan calligraphy print makes a thoughtful gift for someone who loves the name or its meaning.
